R5-251061 Recommendation to RAN5 Leadership to consolidate TDocs Type: discussion For: Endorsement Source: Keysight Technologies UK Ltd Abstract: This contribution intends to suggest a recommendation/guidance to be provided by RAN5 leadership in order to reduce the number of overall CRs treated during each meeting. Discussion Treatment of discussion paper but especially CRs is a time-intensive task for various parties involved: • MCC: implementation of CRs into specs once agreed • RAN5 chairs/vice chairs/convenors/secretaries/assistants: tracking/revising CRs in the respective spreadsheets and databases • Delegates: review/discussion/tracking of CRs internally (meeting preparation) and tracking of CRs during the meeting It is therefore in everyone’s best interest to limit the number of contributions and CRs as much as possible. In RAN4, the RAN4 leadership has formally enforced the number of contributions (discussion, LS, simulations, draft CR/TPs, etc.) for a number of years already [1] and is reminding delegates in their ‘RAN4#X meeting Arrangements and Guidelines’ document every meeting, e.g., • For each individual agenda of all WI/SI-s, the limit of submitted tdoc follows the principle in RAN4 Meeting Efficiency Improvements (R4-2114691) • Maximum one discussion paper per lowest level agenda item (AI) per company/organization in principle. RAN5 obviously has their agenda and TDoc reservation setup very differently than RAN4, e.g., the same spec can be discussed in vastly different agenda items/WIs and different sub-agenda items can be assigned to different clauses of the same spec. In order to optimize the handling of contributions, it is suggested for RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group to encourage each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions. Especially, editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda by each company item should be combined to avoid multiple CRs in the same agenda item. Whether this guidance should be captured in a PRD, e.g., PRD18 (“General processes and practices”), could be discussed separately. We realize that there are exceptions and sometimes separate CRs to a TR/TS might be needed, e.g., essential corrections. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item. Discussion: Keysight USA: concerning proposal 1, it is mostly seen per agenda item, not as an overall recommendation to reduce nr. of docs. Proposal 1 was not recommended, RAN5 will not limit the nr. of contributions. But it is committed to consolidate the nr. of contributions. Proposal 2 can be included in the Chair's reminder. Decision: The document was noted.

RP-190018 TSG SA Report to TSG RAN - Questions for Advice and Requests Type: report For: (not specified) Source: SA chairman (Samsung) Discussion: RAN chair: there will be a joint SA-RAN session starting on Wed 19:00 in RAN room on the REL-17 schedule and slide 15 in general SA chairman: encourages more feedback from RAN and alignment across TSGs in general Decision: The document was noted. NOTE: The following 3 Tdocs RP-190716, RP-190718 an RP-190736 were handled in a joint RAN-SA session on Wed 20.03.2019 at 19:00. RP-190716 Time schedule for Release 17 Type: discussion For: - Source: SA chairman (Samsung) Abstract: input for joint RAN-SA session on Wed (starting at 19:00) Discussion: Tdoc is equal to SP-190245 Agreement in TSG-SA#82: - Stage 1 target date December 2019 (all normative work results to be at or more than 80 % completion by Sept 2019) - The target dates for Release 17 will be reviewed in TSG#86 (=Dec.19) taking the outcome of the 3GPP wide coordination at TSG#86 in December Proposed initial target date in TSG-SA: - Target date for stage 2 freeze is September 2020 - This date will be reviewed in TSG-SA based on agreement of Rel-17 contents and time schedule agreed jointly by SA/RAN SA chairman: this means targeting a 5 quarter REL-17 Ericsson: is correct Huawei: what interests RAN people is the REL-17 stage 3 freeze Qualcomm: so CT1 and RAN2 stage 3 freeze would be June 2021 and RAN1 stage 3 would be March 2021 Mediatek: so agrees with Qualcomm, ASN.1 freeze would then be Sep.2021 Huawei: why were these dates chosen? SA chairman: if we start with 5 quarters, we may end up with 6 quarters but if you start with 6 quarters, we can never reach 5 quarters RAN chairman: could we take 5 quarters for REL-17 as a basis? CMCC: when would this be revisited? SA chairman: by Dec.19 we need to be crystal clear what the target dates are, SA1 is already working on REL-17 CMCC: we do not want to repeat multiple drops that we had in REL-15, this was a mistake RAN chairman: we will revisit if there is a strong need but we will not revisit just in order to revisit RAN3 chairman: what will the REL-size mean in terms of WG workload? SA chairman: we will fill the available time whatever the length of the REL is, a shorter REL will mean less content, that's all OPPO: is expecting a number of verticals will need 3GPP support and therefore 18 months may be better RAN chairman: let's look then at RP-190718 Decision: The document was noted. RP-190718 Decision on Rel-17 schedule Type: discussion For: - Source: RAN chairman (Nokia), SA chairman (Samsung) Abstract: input for joint RAN-SA session on Wed (starting at 19:00) Discussion: proposal: - Majority of company proposals fluctuate between 15 and 18 month long Release-17 - The SA-RAN joint session to identify if there is a decisive reason one way or another (15 vs 18) - If such a decisive reasons does not exist, it is proposed to conduct a show of hands between 15 and 18, and adopt majority view Huawei: we would prefer to plan with an 18 months REL without delay which gives some more time for SIs Qualcomm: a longer REL has the danger that some industry comes and claims there feature is so urgent that it needs to be addressed asap and we end up with drops again, this is one argument for a 15 months REL Ericsson: would prefer to avoid a show of hands decision but plan with a 15 months REL and we can revisit in Dec.19 RAN chairman: would not like to keep the decision open until Dec.19 as we have then 2 variables (length of the REL and contents of the REL) LG: if the amount of work for 15 months and for 18 months, then we prefer 18 months, so it is important that TSGs plan the workload properly CMCC: we would prefer to fix a time line and to stick to it to avoid a bad impression to the outside ZTE: proper TU pl

nd Endorsement Introduction This contribution intends to suggest a recommendation/guidance to be provided by RAN5 leadership in order to reduce the number of overall CRs treated during each meeting. Discussion Treatment of discussion paper but especially CRs is a time-intensive task for various parties involved: MCC: implementation of CRs into specs once agreed RAN5 chairs/vice chairs/convenors/secretaries/assistants: tracking/revising CRs in the respective spreadsheets and databases Delegates: review/discussion/tracking of CRs internally (meeting preparation) and tracking of CRs during the meeting It is therefore in everyone’s best interest to limit the number of contributions and CRs as much as possible. In RAN4, the RAN4 leadership has formally enforced the number of contributions (discussion, LS, simulations, draft CR/TPs, etc.) for a number of years already [1] and is reminding delegates in their ‘RAN4#X meeting Arrangements and Guidelines’ document every meeting, e.g., RAN5 obviously has their agenda and TDoc reservation setup very differently than RAN4, e.g., the same spec can be discussed in vastly different agenda items/WIs and different sub-agenda items can be assigned to different clauses of the same spec. In order to optimize the handling of contributions, it is suggested for RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group to encourage each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions. Especially, editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda by each company item should be combined to avoid multiple CRs in the same agenda item. Whether this guidance should be captured in a PRD, e.g., PRD18 (“General processes and practices”), could be discussed separately. We realize that there are exceptions and sometimes separate CRs to a TR/TS might be needed, e.g., essential corrections. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item. Conclusion The following observations and conclusions were made in this contribution. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item. RAN2/3 NR Source: NTT DOCOMO, INC. Decision: The document was revised to RP-172014. RP-172014 Updated work plan of RAN2/3 NR Source: NTT DOCOMO, INC. (Replaces RP-171715) Discussion: proposal: TSG-RAN provides the guidance for RAN2/3 in the next quarter to focus on the essential issues for EN-DC highlighted in this paper RAN chair: RAN2 already widely compliant to this? RAN2 chair: yes mainly, 3/4 NSA, 1/4 SA Qualcomm: this Tdoc seems to say focus on NSA so some details need more discussion LG: mainly fine with the Tdoc but some aspects to be discussed Samsung: most of Tdocs were not treated in RAN2, we should not stop SA discussions completely Nokia: supports Samsung statement that SA work shall not be stopped, e.g. important for slicing ZTE: supports Samsung and Nokia RAN chair: what information from RAN could help RAN2? RAN2 chair: some parts require further discussion so some guidance from RAN will help Interdigital: user plane needs to be completed for NSA and SA by Dec.17 Ericsson: RAN1 needs to be also aligned with the parts that have to be completed in RAN2 by Dec.17 RAN chair: we should have a separate Tdoc for RAN2 with the priorities ATT: wondering about "RAN2 works on RRC configuration required for this mobility type" RAN2 chair: this is a clarification for the bullet above RAN chair: could we do this on Monday evening in parallel to RAN1? seems so Samsung: if there are no mutual impacts, that's fine RAN3 part: NEC: whole split SRB on hold? RAN3 chair: RRC message transfer function does not take much time but clarifies that RAN3 is overloaded RAN chair: we need a Tdoc addressing the RAN3 NR WI priorities and also what to do with the SIs Deutsche Telekom: why is SON deprioritized? NTT DOCOMO: was deprioritized in RAN2 RAN chair: it seems for RAN3 we need to mainly clarify the handling of SI and this will be done in the revision of RP-172008 RAN3 chair: if RAN2 is downpriotizing something, then RAN3 will follow conclusion: RAN chair: RAN2 part will be discussed on Monday evening in breakout room Lilac with output in RP-172027 Decision: The document was noted. RP-172027 Updated work plan of RAN2 NR Source: RAN2 chairman (Intel) Discussion: Samsung: bullet 2 on slide 3 unclear RAN2 chair: you interpret "completed" stricter than I intended, not every detail needs to be completed; so better replace "completion" by "treatment" Orange: options 4 and 7: any priorities planned? RAN2 chair: many things applicable for option 2 and option 3 apply also to other options so we will still address them, things that are only relevant for option 4 will not be treated conclusion: "completion" will be changed into "treatment" Decision: The document was revised to RP-172068.
